name: Hayachine Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Mt. Hayachine, the 'holy peak of the north' in the Kitakami mountains, with rare alpine flora and a shrine on its summit.
notes: Managed by Iwate. The mountain is a full-day hike from the trailhead.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.name: 早池峰国定公園
ja.description: 北上山地にそびえる「北の霊峰」早池峰山の国定公園。希少な高山植物と山頂の神社が魅力的。
ja.notes: 岩手県が管理。登山口から山頂まで終日かかる本格的な登山となる。
